content: PLAUSIBLE — `FileUploadSizeException` covers both whole-request limits and per-part byte limits, so oversized multipart envelope/fields can be reported as `reason=file_too_large`; count violations are separately caught first as `too_many_parts`. But the public contract only specifies an 8 MiB direct-upload limit and `artifact.invalid_upload` with an unconstrained `reason`, so this is not a concrete acceptance-contract violation.
